evidence_policy.unknown_rule: Absence from the authorized current-Run evidence set is recorded as not observed or unknown, never as proof that a capability does not exist.
evidence_policy.model_non_conflation_rule: runtime.route.attested and the model field on agent.turn.completed bindings are separate facts. model=gpt-5.6-sol is not end-to-end proof of Claude model execution.
